bodies: FAA-Accepted Flight Instructor Refresher Course Providers

exams.name: Aircraft Dispatcher Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on meteorology, flight planning, performance and regulations required for the FAA aircraft dispatcher certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Helicopter Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for pilots who already hold an ATP certificate and are adding a rotorcraft-helicopter category and class rating.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test allowing holders of a Canadian airline transport helicopter licence to obtain the equivalent FAA certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test covering helicopter aerodynamics, performance, weather and air carrier operations for the ATP rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question conversion test for Canadian airline transport pilots seeking an FAA multiengine airplane ATP certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 125-question four-hour test on transport-category performance, meteorology, crew resource management and Part 121 operations.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Single Engine Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test for Canadian licence holders adding an FAA single-engine airplane airline transport pilot certificate.

exams.name: Airline Transport Pilot Single Engine Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 90-question test covering advanced aerodynamics, weather, navigation and regulations for a single-engine airplane ATP certificate.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian commercial pilot aeroplane licence into an FAA commercial pilot certificate.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on commercial privileges, complex aircraft systems, performance charts and Part 135 rules for paid flying.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on lighter-than-air airship aerodynamics, ballonets, ground handling and commercial operating rules.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Balloon Gas Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test covering gas balloon systems, ballast management, weather and commercial privileges for balloon pilots.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Balloon Hot Air Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on hot air balloon envelopes, burners, launch site selection and carrying passengers for compensation.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on soaring meteorology, tow procedures, glider performance and commercial operating limitations.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test covering autorotation, rotor systems, gyroplane performance and commercial pilot privileges in rotorcraft.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian commercial helicopter licence to an FAA commercial pilot rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Commercial Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on helicopter performance, weight and balance, external loads and commercial rotorcraft operating rules.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Reciprocating Engine Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for existing flight engineers adding a reciprocating engine class rating to their certificate.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Reciprocating Engine Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on piston powerplants, aircraft systems and performance for the flight engineer reciprocating engine rating.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turbojet Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for certificated flight engineers adding a turbojet class rating to an existing certificate.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turbojet Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test covering turbine engines, pressurisation, hydraulics and electrical systems for turbojet flight engineers.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turboprop Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for flight engineers adding a turbopropeller class rating to a certificate already held.

exams.name: Flight Engineer Turboprop Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on turbopropeller powerplants, propeller control and transport aircraft systems for flight engineer applicants.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Airplane Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for instructors holding a CFI certificate in another category who are adding an airplane rating.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on flight training procedures, stall and spin awareness, endorsements and instructor responsibilities for airplane CFIs.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Glider Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for existing flight instructors adding a glider category rating to their instructor certificate.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test covering glider instruction techniques, tow signals, soaring weather and student endorsements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Gyroplane Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for certificated instructors adding a gyroplane class rating to an existing CFI certificate.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on gyroplane instruction, rotor blade management, autorotation training and student pilot endorsements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Helicopter Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 25-question test for instructors adding a rotorcraft-helicopter rating to a flight instructor certificate already held.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test on helicopter teaching methods, settling with power, autorotation instruction and instructor record keeping.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Airplane Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 20-question test for instrument instructors in another category adding the instrument-airplane instructor rating.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on teaching instrument procedures, approach charts, IFR regulations and partial-panel training for CFII applicants.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Helicopter Added Rating Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 20-question test for instrument instructors adding the instrument-helicopter rating to their instructor certificate.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Instrument Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test covering instrument instruction in helicopters, IFR procedures and instrument student endorsement requirements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Refresher Course
exams.body: FAA-Accepted Flight Instructor Refresher Course Providers
exams.blurb: FAA-accepted 16-hour refresher course used by certificated flight instructors to renew their certificate every 24 calendar months.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for sport pilot instructors teaching in light-sport airplanes, covering instruction technique and sport pilot rules.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Balloon Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors providing sport pilot training in lighter-than-air balloons under Part 61 Subpart K.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for sport pilot instructors delivering glider instruction, including launch procedures and soaring safety.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors teaching sport pilot applicants in gyroplanes, covering rotor handling and training methodology.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Lighter-Than-Air Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for sport pilot instructors in the lighter-than-air airship class, covering buoyancy control and instruction.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors teaching powered parachute sport pilots, covering canopy handling, wind limits and endorsements.

exams.name: Flight Instructor Sport Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 70-question test for instructors of weight-shift-control trikes covering control inputs, teaching technique and sport pilot limits.

exams.name: Flight Navigator Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test on celestial and dead-reckoning navigation, charts and instruments for the FAA flight navigator certificate.

exams.name: Fundamentals of Instructing Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on learning theory, human behaviour, teaching methods and evaluation required of all flight and ground instructor applicants.

exams.name: Ground Instructor Advanced Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 100-question test qualifying holders to give ground instruction for any certificate or rating other than instrument.

exams.name: Ground Instructor Basic Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 80-question test for the basic ground instructor certificate, limited to sport, recreational and private pilot instruction.

exams.name: Ground Instructor Instrument Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test qualifying holders to provide ground instruction for the instrument rating and instrument proficiency checks.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test for Canadian instrument-rated aeroplane pilots seeking the equivalent FAA instrument rating.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test covering IFR regulations, approach plates, holding procedures, icing and instrument navigation systems.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Foreign Pilot Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test taken by foreign licence holders adding an FAA instrument rating on the basis of a foreign pilot certificate.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question conversion test for Canadian instrument-rated helicopter pilots applying for the FAA instrument-helicopter rating.

exams.name: Instrument Rating Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on IFR rules, helicopter instrument approaches, weather and navigation for the instrument-helicopter rating.

exams.name: Military Competence Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question regulations test allowing qualified military aeroplane pilots to obtain a civil FAA pilot certificate.

exams.name: Military Competence Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on civil regulations and airspace enabling military helicopter pilots to convert to FAA certificates.

exams.name: Military Competence Instructor Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 125-question test for military instructor pilots seeking a civilian flight instructor certificate on the basis of service experience.

exams.name: Part 107 Small UAS Initial Training for Part 61 Pilots
exams.blurb: Online course allowing current Part 61 pilots with a flight review to earn a remote pilot certificate without sitting the UAG test.

exams.name: Part 107 Small UAS Recurrent Training
exams.blurb: Free online course remote pilots complete every 24 calendar months to keep Part 107 certificate privileges current.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airplane Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian private pilot aeroplane licence into an FAA private pilot certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on airspace, weather, sectional charts, weight and balance and regulations for the private pilot certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airplane Recreational Pilot Transition Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 30-question bridging test for recreational pilots upgrading to a private pilot airplane certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on airship buoyancy, envelope pressure, mooring and airspace rules for private airship pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Balloon Gas Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on gas balloon inflation, ballast, valve operation and weather for the private pilot balloon rating.

exams.name: Private Pilot Balloon Hot Air Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on hot air balloon systems, launch and landing site selection, surface winds and balloon regulations.

exams.name: Private Pilot Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on glider aerodynamics, aerotow and winch launch procedures, thermals and airspace for glider pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test covering gyroplane rotor systems, prerotation, performance limits and general aviation regulations.

exams.name: Private Pilot Gyroplane Recreational Pilot Transition Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 30-question bridging test for recreational gyroplane pilots moving up to private pilot privileges.

exams.name: Private Pilot Helicopter Canadian Conversion Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test converting a Canadian private helicopter licence into an FAA private pilot rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on helicopter aerodynamics, height-velocity diagrams, weather and airspace for private rotorcraft pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Helicopter Recreational Pilot Transition Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 30-question bridging test for recreational helicopter pilots upgrading to a private pilot rotorcraft certificate.

exams.name: Private Pilot Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on powered parachute canopies, launch technique, wind limitations and airspace for private pilots.

exams.name: Private Pilot Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on weight-shift-control trike handling, performance, weather and regulations for private pilot applicants.

exams.name: Recreational Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test for the recreational pilot certificate, which limits pilots to smaller aircraft and nearby airports.

exams.name: Recreational Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test covering gyroplane basics and the operating limitations that apply to recreational pilot certificate holders.

exams.name: Recreational Pilot Helicopter Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 50-question test on helicopter fundamentals and recreational pilot restrictions such as distance and passenger limits.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Airplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on light-sport aircraft limits, airspace, weather and regulations for the sport pilot certificate.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Glider Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on glider operations within sport pilot privileges, including launch methods and airspace rules.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Gyroplane Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test covering gyroplane handling and the sport pilot operating limitations set out in Part 61 Subpart J.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Lighter-Than-Air Airship Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on light-sport airship operation, buoyancy control and sport pilot rules for lighter-than-air aircraft.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Lighter-Than-Air Balloon Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on balloon systems, launch site assessment and sport pilot privileges for lighter-than-air balloon pilots.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on powered parachute operation, canopy inflation, surface wind limits and sport pilot regulations.

exams.name: Sport Pilot Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 40-question test on weight-shift-control trike operation and sport pilot limitations on airspace, altitude and passengers.

exams.name: The Recreational UAS Safety Test
exams.blurb: Free online safety test that every recreational drone flyer in the United States must pass and carry proof of completion.

exams.name: Unmanned Aircraft General Small Knowledge Test
exams.blurb: 60-question test on airspace, weather, loading and drone regulations required for the Part 107 remote pilot certificate.
